title: The picker's photos are cut several at a time and once each, and few frames on the any-photo rung look further ahead, with the same results
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Cuts finishing in any order give the code half and the picker the same marks, shortlists, codes, thumbnails and files, with more than one and at most CUTS_AT_ONCE cuts in flight.
With one cut memo for the code half and the picker, each photo is cut once for each picker frame; a cut that throws is made again.
One frame left on the any-photo rung has more than LOOK_AHEAD looks in flight, with the same placements, ladder and verdicts as three at a time.

tests: cuts that finish in any order give the code half and the picker the same photos, in the same order
one memo for the code half and the picker cuts each photo for each picker frame once
a cut that throws is not kept: the next ask makes it again
few frames on the rung look further ahead, so their looks fill the looker, and the ladder decides the same
